party.description: A business named on a merger matter. Reproduced as the ACCC public register spells it, including its capitalisation.

identifierType.description: Kind of company identifier carried in identifier. An open set: the register occasionally publishes others.

identifier.description: Company identifier exactly as published, spacing included (e.g. "48 135 315 767").

industry.description: An ANZSIC 2006 code the ACCC tagged on the matter. Tagged at whatever level the ACCC chose - a division letter, or a 1-4 digit number - and occasionally mistyped on the register. Reproduced as published rather than corrected.

determination.description: A determination the ACCC made on a matter. A matter can carry more than one: a phase 1 referral to phase 2 is itself a determination, and is followed by a phase 2 determination, which a public benefit determination can follow in turn if the parties apply for one.

outcome.description: Outcome as the register labels it. The register records a conditional clearance as a plain "Approved" and carries the conditions separately - see withConditions.

decidedOn.description: Date of the determination as YYYY-MM-DD. A date rather than a timestamp because that is all the register publishes.

withConditions.description: Whether the clearance carries conditions. Derived from the determination document, not a field the ACCC publishes.

documentUrl.description: The determination document on the ACCC register.

event.description: One dated entry from the matter's "Decisions and key events" timeline.

date.description: Date of the event as YYYY-MM-DD.

phase.description: Phase the event falls in. A shorter vocabulary than a matter's phase, because it is the label the register puts on the timeline entry itself.

kind.description: Classification applied by mergers.fyi, not by the ACCC.

documentUrl.description: Document published with the event, on the ACCC register or the Australian Competition Tribunal's site.

appeal.description: A review of an ACCC determination outside the ACCC - a merits review in the Australian Competition Tribunal, or a judicial review in the Federal Court.

caseNumber.description: The forum's own matter number (e.g. "ACT 1 of 2026", "NSD1310/2026").

filedOn.description: Date the application was filed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

outcome.description: Result once the review has concluded. Absent while it is on foot.
